Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can.  In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand because you don't have any security cards, therefore you just perform .
Card Q&A.q: Can I also activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, ＜Recovery +1＞. (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)
[Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a [Glowing Dawn] trait Digimon card, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, reduce the cost by 2.
Inherited Effect: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
